rows.label: Domestic programmes expenses, fiscal 2025

source.title: World Vision, Inc., Form 990 for the year ended 30 September 2025 (IRS e-file, object id 202611209349301676)
source.quote: ExpenseAmt 230992460 GrantAmt 163175272 ... DOMESTIC PROGRAMS ... PRIMARILY THROUGH THE DISTRIBUTION OF DONATED PRODUCTS

rows.explainer: Distribution of donated goods (clothing, hygiene items, school supplies, household goods, building materials) through US churches, schools and nonprofits, from World Vision's warehouses. The audited combined statements show $231,759k (GAAP basis); the 990 figure is used so the three programme lines add up to its total.
